sched-netres-lb.held_out_note: Fixed 7 Nov 2026 16:1x Dubai, before any model was fit, on a frozen snapshot of every NR_*/lb/RESULTS.tsv, netres_lb.log and netres_lb_pass3.log taken 7 Nov 12:02:28 UTC. A row's pass comes from the log that printed it: pass 1 (1-3 Nov, 30 s, caps from the 1 Nov published LB; NR_SP 14,466 rows, NR_AD 575) and pass 3 (7 Nov, 15 s, caps from the refreshed published LB; NR_RU, NR_VAR, NR_RC, NR_TF, NR_AD so far). A find = a row whose record has LB or CLOSED (a proven lower bound above the run's starting LB). Cells: (1) NR_TF held out: train on every other snapshot row, test on NR_TF's pass-3 rows; (2) time split: train on pass 1 only, test on the pass-3 rows of NR_RU, NR_VAR, NR_RC and NR_AD (disjoint from cell 1's test); (3) prospective: the model fit on the whole snapshot ranks the pass-3 instances not yet run at the snapshot (rest of NR_AD, NR_SP), scored when pass 3 ends; (4) prospective: the same model ranks pass 3b's candidates (the pass-3 misses, 40 s, runs/sched/pass3b.py), scored from lb3b/RESULTS.tsv rows written after the snapshot. Per cell: K = 20% of its instances (rounded down); model arm = the K instances the model ranks highest, control arm = the first K in the plain order, both judged by the runs already made at the same budget (every test instance was run, so each arm's yield is exactly what running only its K would have given); finds decide (registry verdict). Also reported: random K (exact mean K x base rate and the 2.5-97.5% range of 2,000 seeded draws), K = 10% and 50%, and the LB units gained. Features: only what is known before a run (the network and resource profile from netres.network()/resset() and the ResSet header, the run's starting LB and UB); no set identity, no budget, no earlier run outcome. Model v1 fixed in advance: scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingClassifier(learning_rate 0.05, max_iter 400, max_leaf_nodes 31, min_samples_leaf 40, l2_regularization 1.0, early stopping on 15% of the training rows, random_state 0). Added 7 Nov 16:5x Dubai, before any of its rows or cell 3's score were looked at: pass 3 ended at 16:39 when its process pool broke, so cell 3 is what pass 3 itself wrote after the snapshot (as registered); (5) NetRes pass 3c (prospective) = the open instances pass 3 never ran, run by runs/sched/pass3b.py --missing (15 s, caps from the current LB, rows in NR_*/lb3c/RESULTS.tsv), ranked by the same frozen predictions, same K rule and verdict, scored when pass 3c ends. | 8 Nov 2026 17:25 UTC (21:25 Dubai): two prospective cells added for v2 before any lb6 outcome existed on this machine (no NR_*/lb6 folder; the four lb6 Kaggle kernels still RUNNING, nothing fetched): the 7,200 lb6 tasks (runs/kaggle_netres/dataset_lb6/tasks.jsonl, 90 s each, chosen by v1's order_lb6_20261108.tsv), K = 20% of the scored rows; arm v2 = its frozen top-K, control = the plain first-K, and separately control = v1's frozen top-K (a loss to v1 counts as a loss). sched-netres-lb-params.held_out_note: Fixed 7 Nov 2026 20:4x Dubai (16:4x UTC), before any model of the lane was fit and before any training or test run of it was looked at (the 7 Nov settings A/B in runs/sched/ab/ had been seen: A 10, B 9 of 40 at 40 s; A 0, B 4 of 40 at 20 s). Choice: A or B = LB_PARAMS + linearization_level: 2, per instance, at 40 s. Training data (instances run with both settings side by side at 40 s): runs/sched/ab/lbparams_20261107_1918.json without its NR_TF rows, and runs/sched/model_rerun/phase1 (the pass-3c misses of lane sched-netres-rerun's cell 3: setting A from that cell's arms, setting B run alongside, tag params:train; launched 20:45 Dubai). Features: lane sched-netres-rerun's 36 (lane sched-netres-lb's 33 pre-run features and the 15 s short run's outcome). Model v1 fixed in advance (engine/models/sched_netres_params.py): two HistGradientBoostingClassifiers P(find | A), P(find | B) (learning_rate 0.05, max_iter 200, max_leaf_nodes 15, min_samples_leaf 20, l2_regularization 1.0, no early stopping, random_state 0); pick B when P_B > P_A, else A. Test cells, drawn 20:47 Dubai by sched_netres_params.py draw before any result (runs/sched/model_params/cells.tsv): S1 = the 200 pass-3c misses still open with the highest lane sched-netres-lb v1 frozen probability (runs/sched/model_v1/pred_snapshot_20261107T120228Z.tsv), outside the rerun lane's cell-3 sample of 750 (pool 2,339); S2 = the 200 NR_TF pass-3 misses still open with the highest such probability, outside both 7 Nov settings A/B runs and not yet printed by pass 3b (pool 1,862; NR_TF is in no training row). Every test instance runs with A and with B at 40 s (jobs_phase2.tsv: A and B adjacent, order alternating, one pool of nice-10 workers on the Mac, engine/models/netres_jobs.py); the control arm is each instance's A run, the model arm is the run of the setting the frozen model picked (picks.tsv, written and committed after phase 1 and before any phase-2 result is read), so the two arms are the same run wherever the model picks A. Verdict: finds (a proven bound above the starting LB), then the registry rule. Also reported: fixed B, the better of A and B per instance, instances found by only one setting, LB units, seconds.

sched-netres-lb-params.status_note: 8 Nov 01:2x Dubai: v1 lost S1 (127 vs 132 finds) and tied S2 (123 vs 123), so it is never promoted. Where it switched to B, B alone found 16 and A alone 21 (S1), 10 and 10 (S2): the T-learner did not learn which instances favour linearization level 2. The two settings are strongly complementary at 40 s (the better of A and B per instance: 158 and 149 finds against A's 132 and 123), so the next candidate is a portfolio (A then B within the same seconds) or a stronger selector, not v1. Side result: phases 1 and 2 proved 490 bounds above the dataset LB (NR_AD 341, NR_TF 149; 693 LB units) in runs/sched/model_rerun/phase1/RESULTS.tsv and runs/sched/model_params/phase2/RESULTS.tsv, not yet merged into NR_* (make_upload reads lb3b, lb3c, lb4).
